story: Explore the fascinating world of the Speckled Wood Pigeon (Urocissa ornata). Classified under the Corvidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Humid forest from lowlands to hills; dense wet evergreen temperate rainforest. The current IUCN classification of Vulnerable (VU) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Speckled Wood Pigeon is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Speckled Wood Pigeon, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
